checks.claim: EA Time Stamped DTM is available at 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m resolution depending on survey.
Time Stamped DTM is downloaded as GeoTIFF rasters.
Time Stamped DTM is packaged in 5 km zip files.
Time Stamped DTM elevations are presented in metres.
Time Stamped DTM heights reference Ordnance Survey Newlyn.
Time Stamped DTM is aligned to the OS Grid.
Time Stamped DTM vertical accuracy is +/-15 cm RMSE.
The coordinate transformation used can depend on survey time period.
Metadata index catalogues provide the specific survey dates for a location.
Metadata index catalogues provide product resolution for a location.
Metadata index catalogues identify transformation used for a survey.
Metadata index catalogues identify geoidal model used for a survey.
